plan.title: Android App 产品历史只读接入与真实纵向 E2E
source_and_capability_contract: canonical DB 行命中时用产品投影；DB miss 沿既有 snapshot/recovery；DB read error 显式失败。

E2E 环境显式启用 TERMLINK_HISTORY_RANGE_SEGMENTS 并协商 cache schema v3；默认 feature flags 不变。两种 capability 同时广告时 App 为产品库请求 range，按实际 response providerMode=product_db 使用 bounded/older；DB miss 的 snapshot/recovery response 按其实际 lane 处理。未协商 range 的环境仅验证全量产品历史，不声称 older。
健康 IPC surface 独占当前正文、operation、当前 turn、运行态；产品历史只提供静态 baseline/更旧前缀。
exclusions: 不改 Rust collector、rollout source identity、Node 产品库事务或单会话单例采集；App/history 查询不得直接触发第二条 Rust 采集链。
不改 IPC follower/owner、desired subscription/replay、healthy IPC authority；不把内部 source_ref、cursor、checkpoint、job/batch/segment 或假设产品 epoch 传给 App。
不扩大到任意本地文件/图片字节访问、Goal/子代理/edited_files 聚合，也不以此关闭 Task 001/002 其他台账项。
准备和确认本身不实施产品代码、Git 提交、部署或真机安装。
plan.goal: Android App 经现有鉴权历史协议读取 Node 已发布 canonical 产品历史，显示真实事件路径、cwd、命令及代码/工具文本；通过真实外部 Codex host 到 Android 的早期纵向 E2E，并保持健康 IPC 的实时 authority。

steps.title: S1 最小可见产品页：用真实 Node product_db DTO 锁定 detailRefs/availability、页哈希与 cache schema；修复不变 payload、变化 detailRefs/detailRefsTruncated/availability 时 complete-root、manifest/diff 和 v3 range 均触发有效更新。payloadHash 保持正文 bytes 校验；验证旧 cache/旧客户端兼容。Android 解析、哈希、持久化与前向迁移，处理 range+snapshot 双能力路由和 DB miss/error，并增加最小结构化 event path/cwd/command/code 事实文本投影。完整详情 UI 留至 S3。

S2 提前真实首屏 smoke：显式开启 range，由真实外部 Codex host 自然产生 rollout，观察 Rust→Node canonical DB→鉴权 Gateway→Android 真机有界首屏和 ACK；校验一个具体结构化事件字段值在 App 可见。若新 schema 会升级已有用户缓存，安装前副本迁移演练、备份及兼容回滚构建；可弃用全新测试设备不需此旧数据步骤。缺宿主/设备则保持 E2E 未验证并继续其他独立工作。
S3 详情与历史流：接入按需详情请求、UTF-8 chunk offset/hash/selection 校验和只读展示/复制；完成 older、append、缓存重开、A→B→A 迟到响应隔离的必要兼容，保持 live IPC 优先。
S4 同一真实场景扩展：验证 older 回填/重叠去重、追加、App/Node 重启、详情变化/失效、健康 IPC 与 A→B→A；保存实际观察、失败和未验证项。

minimum_sufficient_validation: Node：在既有 tests/codexHistoryProductFlow.test.js 增一条不变 payload、变化详情引用/availability 的聚焦回归，覆盖完整 root 快路径与 v3 range 所需比较；复用现有 DB miss/error 与产品流测试，不逐字段造重复用例。
Android：复用一个 Node 产出的 product_db fixture，扩展既有 wire/range/cache 测试覆盖页哈希、引用持久化/重开；扩展现有 ViewModel/UI 映射测试断言一个结构化事件字段的真实可见值；按关键风险验证详情分块与 stale selection。
触及 Gateway、ViewModel 或 selection 后运行合同要求的 Node OwnerSurfaceTracker/terminalGateway.codexIpc 与相关 Android Codex wire/ViewModel JVM 回归；Android Gradle 用 JDK 21，确认任务实际执行。
真机一条真实 host→Rust→Node DB→Gateway→App 场景先首屏后扩展 older、append、重启、详情、IPC A→B→A；使用项目本地开发服务/真机流程，记录 feature flags、设备状态与实际证据。若升级已有缓存，先做一次性副本迁移演练及回滚准备，不额外新增持久自动化测试。
scope: Android Codex history wire、跨端页哈希、SQLite cache 前向迁移与旧缓存兼容、ViewModel range/snapshot 协商和选择隔离、最小事件事实投影及按需只读详情。
Node product history provider/sync 已证实的 detail-ref-only 同步身份问题和必要 Gateway 协议兼容；沿用鉴权 sync/manifest/delta/ACK/chunk/older。
真实外部 Codex host、Rust、Node 产品 DB、鉴权 Gateway、Android 真机首屏与扩展场景验证。
acceptance: 产品库命中、缺记录、读取失败分别遵守 DB-first、既有 fallback、显式失败；range v3 + 服务端启用时初始页有界且 older 使用 product_db 游标。
Node/Android 详情引用与 availability、页哈希一致，缓存重开仍保留。仅详情引用变化也触发新同步 root/diff/upsert；正文 payloadHash 不被错误改写，旧引用/游标按协议失效。
S2 首屏可见真实结构化路径、cwd、命令或代码的具体事件事实；S3 详情分块完整且 offset/hash 有效，不泄露内部采集元数据、不承诺访问源文件或图片字节。
older、append、重启保持幂等与 coverage 真实；stale selection/response 拒绝；健康 IPC 始终掌管实时字段，A→B→A 不串线。
真实外部宿主和 Android 物理设备的首屏与扩展场景各有具体证据；未执行部分明确未验证，不能凭本机替身测试宣称通过。

真机 smoke 观察真实 Rust→Node DB→Gateway→App、older、append、重启、详情与 A→B→A/IPC 并存；按项目真机流程先检查本地开发服务。

reviews.previous_finding_resolution: The revised plan addresses all five findings from the prior self-review: DB-first with not-found fallback and explicit DB error; explicit range configuration and both-capability precedence; detail-ref-only sync refresh; early real initial-page smoke; representative App-visible event fact validation.

findings.title: S2 visible event fact depends on work currently scheduled in S3
findings.evidence: S2 accepts a real path/cwd/command/code fact visible on the Android initial page, while S1 only names wire/hash/cache/capability changes. The current CodexViewModel.extractHistoryPayloadTextForUi reads text/content/summary and recursively text/content/input, so a structured path/cwd/command field may still be invisible until the S3 UI work.
findings.resolution: Include the minimum structured event-fact text projection and one real DTO assertion in S1, before S2 smoke. Keep full on-demand detail UI in S3. The S2 smoke should assert a concrete structured field value rather than incidental path text inside a summary.

findings.title: Separate payload integrity from effective sync identity when refs change
findings.evidence: Product provider currently sets item.contentHash=hash(payloadJson), while Node root/manifest/diff and Android cached manifest use contentHash. Payload chunks also have a separate payloadHash. A detail-only update cannot be fixed only by changing projectionSnapshotHash, and an unqualified contentHash change risks conflating payload integrity with item revision semantics for old caches/clients.
findings.resolution: In S1 explicitly choose a compatible effective item/version comparison covering detailRefs, detailRefsTruncated and availability across complete-root, manifest and v3 range paths. Preserve payloadHash as hash of payload bytes, check old-cache reconciliation and wire compatibility, and make the single focused Node regression exercise the relevant complete and range paths.

findings.title: Real-device schema upgrade needs a safe installation boundary
findings.evidence: S1 plans an additive Android SQLite migration and S2 immediately installs on a physical device. The existing AD-004 range migration decision required a copy rehearsal and a compatible rollback build before first upgrade of the main device; a new schema bump is likewise not downgraded merely by disabling a feature flag.
findings.resolution: If S2 uses a device with existing user cache and S1 bumps its DB version, rehearse migration on a copy and preserve backup/compatible rollback before install. A clean disposable test device does not require migration of prior user data.

findings.title: History source wording conflicts with product contract

findings.title: Older-page acceptance lacks capability configuration and precedence
findings.evidence: src/server.js defaults TERMLINK_HISTORY_RANGE_SEGMENTS and TERMLINK_HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_SEGMENTS to off. Android CodexViewModel.kt selects serverSnapshotSegments first and omits rangeSegments when snapshot capability is enabled; Gateway product provider only returns a bounded range when rangeSegments.enabled.
findings.resolution: Lock the E2E/product configuration and behavior when both capabilities are advertised before implementation; preserve snapshot fallback for DB misses. Define how App requests product_db range so initial/older assertions really exercise that lane.

findings.title: Detail refs can change without triggering history refresh
findings.evidence: src/services/codexHistoryProductProvider.js derives item contentHash from payloadJson only while detailRefs are separate. src/services/codexHistorySyncService.js compares item contentHash and has complete-root fast path, so a detail-only update can be reported up-to-date; projectionSnapshotHash does include refs, showing mismatch between cursor invalidation and sync root.
findings.resolution: Include detailRefs/availability in effective canonical item identity or otherwise force the relevant upsert/root change; add one focused Node regression for unchanged payload with changed detail ref.

findings.title: Real App integration is scheduled too late
findings.evidence: Earlier user direction was to connect App early for a vertical E2E to reduce rework. Plan puts true external-host/device smoke after full detail UI and other wiring in S4.
findings.resolution: Run a minimum real host→product DB→Gateway→App initial-page smoke immediately after the S1 wire/hash fix; then expand that same scenario for older, append, restart, detail and IPC coexistence.

findings.resolution: Use a real product DTO fixture to assert one representative path/cwd/command or code fact is visible in App history; extend an existing Android mapping/ViewModel test, avoiding helper-by-helper tests.

reviews.previous_finding_resolution: The revised plan addresses all five findings from the prior self-review: DB-first with not-found fallback and explicit DB error; explicit range configuration and both-capability precedence; detail-ref-only sync refresh; early real initial-page smoke; representative App-visible event fact validation.

findings.title: S2 visible event fact depends on work currently scheduled in S3
findings.evidence: S2 accepts a real path/cwd/command/code fact visible on the Android initial page, while S1 only names wire/hash/cache/capability changes. The current CodexViewModel.extractHistoryPayloadTextForUi reads text/content/summary and recursively text/content/input, so a structured path/cwd/command field may still be invisible until the S3 UI work.
findings.resolution: Include the minimum structured event-fact text projection and one real DTO assertion in S1, before S2 smoke. Keep full on-demand detail UI in S3. The S2 smoke should assert a concrete structured field value rather than incidental path text inside a summary.

findings.title: Separate payload integrity from effective sync identity when refs change
findings.evidence: Product provider currently sets item.contentHash=hash(payloadJson), while Node root/manifest/diff and Android cached manifest use contentHash. Payload chunks also have a separate payloadHash. A detail-only update cannot be fixed only by changing projectionSnapshotHash, and an unqualified contentHash change risks conflating payload integrity with item revision semantics for old caches/clients.
findings.resolution: In S1 explicitly choose a compatible effective item/version comparison covering detailRefs, detailRefsTruncated and availability across complete-root, manifest and v3 range paths. Preserve payloadHash as hash of payload bytes, check old-cache reconciliation and wire compatibility, and make the single focused Node regression exercise the relevant complete and range paths.

findings.title: Real-device schema upgrade needs a safe installation boundary
findings.evidence: S1 plans an additive Android SQLite migration and S2 immediately installs on a physical device. The existing AD-004 range migration decision required a copy rehearsal and a compatible rollback build before first upgrade of the main device; a new schema bump is likewise not downgraded merely by disabling a feature flag.
findings.resolution: If S2 uses a device with existing user cache and S1 bumps its DB version, rehearse migration on a copy and preserve backup/compatible rollback before install. A clean disposable test device does not require migration of prior user data.

reviews.validation_assessment: The proposed new permanent tests are justified by two concrete gaps: unchanged payload with changed refs, and App visibility of a structured event fact. Reuse existing wire/range/cache/ViewModel and Node product flow tests; the real-device smoke supplies integration evidence. No broader suite or helper-by-helper tests are justified. No tests were run in this draft review.

findings.title: History source wording conflicts with product contract
findings.evidence: Plan scope says Node product DB is the only static history source. Product contract §6 says use product projection when canonical row exists, preserve existing snapshot/recovery on miss, and return explicit failure on DB read failure.
findings.resolution: Reword scope/acceptance to DB-first for a found canonical row, bounded legacy fallback only on not-found, and fail-closed on DB read failure; do not disable the preexisting fallback.

findings.title: Older-page acceptance lacks capability configuration and precedence
findings.evidence: src/server.js defaults TERMLINK_HISTORY_RANGE_SEGMENTS and TERMLINK_HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_SEGMENTS to off. Android CodexViewModel.kt selects serverSnapshotSegments first and omits rangeSegments when snapshot capability is enabled; Gateway product provider only returns a bounded range when rangeSegments.enabled.
findings.resolution: Lock the E2E/product configuration and behavior when both capabilities are advertised before implementation; preserve snapshot fallback for DB misses. Define how App requests product_db range so initial/older assertions really exercise that lane.

findings.title: Detail refs can change without triggering history refresh
findings.evidence: src/services/codexHistoryProductProvider.js derives item contentHash from payloadJson only while detailRefs are separate. src/services/codexHistorySyncService.js compares item contentHash and has complete-root fast path, so a detail-only update can be reported up-to-date; projectionSnapshotHash does include refs, showing mismatch between cursor invalidation and sync root.
findings.resolution: Include detailRefs/availability in effective canonical item identity or otherwise force the relevant upsert/root change; add one focused Node regression for unchanged payload with changed detail ref.

findings.title: Real App integration is scheduled too late
findings.evidence: Earlier user direction was to connect App early for a vertical E2E to reduce rework. Plan puts true external-host/device smoke after full detail UI and other wiring in S4.
findings.resolution: Run a minimum real host→product DB→Gateway→App initial-page smoke immediately after the S1 wire/hash fix; then expand that same scenario for older, append, restart, detail and IPC coexistence.

findings.title: User-visible event facts lack a focused regression
findings.evidence: Android extractHistoryPayloadTextForUi currently reads text/content/summary only; plan accepts visible file path, cwd, command and code, but proposed Android tests cover wire/hash/reopen and detail assembly rather than event-fact projection.
findings.resolution: Use a real product DTO fixture to assert one representative path/cwd/command or code fact is visible in App history; extend an existing Android mapping/ViewModel test, avoiding helper-by-helper tests.
